overview:
The Kerala Tour Package is a 6-day journey covering four popular destinations: Cochin, Munnar, Thekkady, and Alleppey. Designed to combine nature, sightseeing, local culture, and relaxation, this itinerary offers a varied experience of Kerala in one convenient holiday.

Begin your journey in Cochin and drive through scenic landscapes to Munnar, known for its tea plantations, waterfalls, and mountain views. Continue to Thekkady for a spice plantation experience and optional cultural performances. In Alleppey, enjoy a traditional Kerala houseboat stay surrounded by coconut palms, paddy fields, and tranquil backwaters. Finish your trip in Cochin with heritage sightseeing before departure.

itinerary.title: Cochin Arrival – Scenic Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Cochin International Airport or Railway Station, where a Safar Trails representative will welcome you and assist with your onward transfer to Munnar.

Enjoy a scenic drive through Kerala's lush countryside, with views of green hills, waterfalls, and tea plantations along the route. En route, visit Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls, subject to available time and weather conditions.

Upon arrival in Munnar, check in to your hotel and relax after the journey. Spend the evening at leisure.
itinerary.morningActivity: Arrival at Cochin International Airport or Railway Station & meet Safar Trails representative
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic drive through Western Ghats, Cheeyappara & Valara Waterfalls (time/weather permitting)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check in to your hotel in Munnar & evening at leisure

itinerary.title: Munnar Local Sightseeing – Tea Gardens and Mountain Views
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed for a full day of sightseeing in Munnar.

Visit Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake, where you can enjoy scenic surroundings and panoramic views of the Western Ghats. Explore Munnar's beautiful tea gardens and discover the region's tea-growing heritage.

You may also visit a tea museum, subject to its opening days and timings.

Return to the hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & visit to Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore Munnar's tea gardens & optional Tea Museum visit (subject to timings)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening in Munnar

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady – Spice Plantation Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed towards Thekkady, enjoying a scenic drive through the Western Ghats.

Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Later, visit a spice plantation to learn about Kerala's famous spices and their cultivation.

In the evening, you may opt to attend a traditional Kathakali performance or Kalaripayattu show, subject to availability and additional charges.

Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in at hotel and guided visit to a spice plantation
itinerary.eveningActivity: Optional traditional Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show; dinner at hotel

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey – Kerala Houseboat Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed towards Alleppey, famous for its scenic backwaters and traditional houseboats.

Upon arrival, board your houseboat and begin a relaxing cruise through Kerala's beautiful waterways. Enjoy views of coconut palms, paddy fields, village life, and peaceful canals as you experience the charm of the backwaters.

Enjoy freshly prepared meals onboard and spend the evening relaxing on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin – Heritage and City Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the houseboat and proceed towards Cochin.

Explore the historic charm of Fort Kochi, including the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, and the heritage streets of the area.

Later, visit Mattancherry Palace, subject to opening days and timings. Spend the evening at leisure, exploring local markets or shopping for souvenirs.

Check in to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Cochin Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Depending on your departure schedule, enjoy some free time in Cochin.

A private transfer will take you to Cochin International Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

Depart with wonderful memories of Kerala's tea-covered hills, spice plantations, peaceful backwaters, and cultural heritage.

Your Kerala holiday concludes with Safar Trails.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Cochin – Heritage, Culture and Coastal Charm
topPlacesToVisit.description: Cochin (Kochi) combines historic architecture, local markets, and coastal scenery. Places to explore include Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, Mattancherry Palace, and historic streets and local markets. Recommended experience: Explore Fort Kochi's heritage area and discover local crafts and souvenirs.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Munnar – Tea Plantations and Scenic Hills
topPlacesToVisit.description: Munnar is known for its rolling tea gardens, misty mountain landscapes, and beautiful viewpoints. Places to explore include Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Munnar Tea Gardens, Tea Museum (subject to timings), and Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls en route. Recommended experience: Enjoy scenic drives and panoramic views across the tea-covered hills.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Thekkady – Spice Plantations and Cultural Experiences
topPlacesToVisit.description: Thekkady introduces visitors to Kerala's spice-growing heritage and cultural traditions. Visit a spice plantation to learn about Kerala's famous spices, or opt for a traditional Kathakali performance or Kalaripayattu martial arts show (subject to availability).

topPlacesToVisit.name: Alleppey – Backwaters and Traditional Houseboats
topPlacesToVisit.description: Alleppey (Alappuzha) is famous for its tranquil backwaters, coconut-lined canals, and traditional houseboats. Experience highlights include an overnight houseboat stay, scenic backwater cruise, views of villages and paddy fields, and freshly prepared meals onboard as per the confirmed package.

faqs.question: How many days are enough for a Kerala tour?
faqs.answer: A 5 Nights / 6 Days Kerala tour package gives you time to explore Cochin, Munnar, Thekkady, and Alleppey, including tea gardens, spice plantations, heritage sightseeing, and a houseboat stay.

faqs.question: Which destinations are covered in this Kerala holiday package?
faqs.answer: The itinerary covers Cochin, Munnar, Thekkady, and Alleppey, starting and ending in Cochin.

faqs.question: Is a houseboat stay included in the Kerala tour package?
faqs.answer: The itinerary includes a traditional houseboat stay in Alleppey. The houseboat category and exact meal arrangements should be confirmed in the final quotation.

faqs.question: Are meals included in the package?
faqs.answer: Meals are provided according to the selected package plan. Freshly prepared meals are served onboard the houseboat as described in the itinerary. Confirm the exact hotel meal plan before booking.

faqs.question: Is this Kerala tour package suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Yes, the itinerary may suit families looking for a mix of nature, sightseeing, cultural experiences, and a houseboat stay. Confirm room arrangements and any specific requirements when requesting a quote.

faqs.question: Can couples book this Kerala holiday package?
faqs.answer: Yes. The scenic tea gardens of Munnar and the relaxing houseboat experience in Alleppey may appeal to couples planning a getaway.

faqs.question: Are Kathakali and Kalaripayattu shows included?
faqs.answer: These performances are listed as optional experiences and are subject to availability. Ask Safar Trails whether tickets can be added to your package quotation.

faqs.question: Are flights included in the Kerala package?
faqs.answer: Flights and train tickets are not listed as confirmed inclusions. Transfers to and from Cochin Airport or Railway Station are arranged as stated in your confirmed package.

faqs.question: Can I customise my Kerala tour itinerary?
faqs.answer: You can enquire about travel dates, accommodation preferences, and additional requirements. Changes depend on availability and confirmation by Safar Trails.

faqs.question: How can I book a Kerala tour package with Safar Trails?
faqs.answer: Share your travel dates, number of travellers, preferred accommodation, and room requirements. Safar Trails can provide a quotation for review before you confirm your booking.
